readout_other: Electrical impedance tomography; modified neurologic severity score; rotarod test; TTC infarct staining; BDNF western blot
direction_notes: tFUS after MCAO lowered ipsilateral and whole-brain impedance, improved mNSS from day 3, and reduced infarct volume; rotarod, weight and BDNF changes were not significant versus MCAO.

target.label: right hemisphere of the brain (the same side as the occluded hemisphere)

device.manufacturer: Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
device.model: single crystal focused ultrasonic transducer, 3 cm diameter

timing.protocol_description: Pulse width 500 us, pulse interval 1 ms, stimulation duration 300 ms, stimulation interval 3 s, applied for 20 minutes daily for 3 consecutive days starting 24 h after MCAO.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Seventy-six rats were used in this experiment, with 40 randomly assigned to the experimental group and 36 to the control group.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: In the MCAO + tFUS group, tFUS was administered daily for 3 consecutive days after surgery.

flags.reason: 76 rats enrolled (40 experimental, 36 control); sample sizes per outcome vary (n = 16/18, 6, 4/5, 3, 11/5).
Paper gives pulse width 500 microseconds and pulse interval 1 ms; unclear whether interval is off-time or period, so PRF and duty cycle not derived.
Stated stimulation duration 300 ms with a 3 s stimulation interval; total 20 min per day.
Ispta 450.5 mW/cm2 converted to 0.4505 W/cm2; domain not stated.
Transducer from Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, a research institute; classed custom_built.
Target is the right (ipsilateral to MCAO) hemisphere; no specific structure.
MCAO control received same procedures without tFUS; how (device off or not) not described.
Rats anaesthetised with isoflurane for tFUS; behavioural testing state not stated.
Outcomes were impedance, behaviour, infarct volume and BDNF, not neural excitability.
